subject: Welcome to Redwood — quick checklist + schedule link

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — quick checklist + schedule link

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for signing up for Redwood — welcome! I wanted to send a quick set of next steps so you can get a high-value demo on the calendar with one of our SDRs.

Quick checklist before the call (helps us make the 30 minutes productive):
- Confirm the primary use case you want us to evaluate (LLM-powered search, summarization, embeddings, etc.)
- Identify any security or data questions up front (your cloud/security lead is welcome to join)
- If possible, bring a short prompt or example document we can use to reproduce your workflow

Schedule: please pick a slot that works for you here: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/30min-demo?event=acme
Or if you prefer, reply with 2-3 preferred times and Ben (cc'd) will lock it in.

Attachment: [redwood-30min-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 112 KB)]

Ben will handle the SDR handoff and run the demo — I’ll stay looped in for any enterprise or security-specific follow-ups.

Mina Haddad
Enterprise SDR Lead | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
